title: Neon Racer: Miami '86
description: 3D 1986 Miami synthwave highway racer. Carve through sunset traffic in sculpted 80s supercars, chain near-miss combos, trigger true timed Shield/Magnet/Turbo/Chill Wave buffs, and unlock rides in the Miami Garage.

maker.name: KouziTech
maker.bio: KouziTech is an AI-first game studio pushing the boundaries of generative AI in game development. Every game is designed, built, and polished using AI-assisted workflows — proving that high-quality games can be created faster than ever before. We specialize in HTML5 browser games that work everywhere: no downloads, no installations, no plugins. Just click and play.

instructions: Race down a 3D 1986 Miami synthwave causeway at sunset. Carve through coupes, vans, and telegraphing lane-swappers, chain near-miss combos, collect coins for the Miami Garage, and grab timed Shield, Magnet, Turbo, and Chill Wave power-ups.
